findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: There is a massive leak at the handwashing sink in the back dish room. The PIC mentioned that the facility is aware of the leak. It appears that two pieces of piping have been disconnected, causing a gap for contaminated water to leak onto the floor. Ensure that the sink is repaired by a licensed plumber. Will follow-up on July 20, 2026 to ensure that plumbing has been repaired and is in leak free condition.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Both bathroom handsinks were observed with a small gap between the wall and the back of the hand-sink. The current caulk has peeled from the wall and is need of re-caulking. See that both sinks are re-caulked to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
There was debris accumulation observed in the following areas:
- food debris on the shelf of the prep table in front of the pizza oven (where to go boxes are stored)
- debris underneath triple sink
- debris underneath storage rack across from triple sink

Shown to PIC. Discussed cleaning floors and hard to reach areas as frequent as necessary to keep them clean. Ensure to educate all staff members on proper cleaning.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
There were several missing floor tiles in the following areas:
- a couple of missing floor tiles around the mop sink
- a missing tile near the back door
- a missing tile near the pieces of laundry equipment 

Ensure that missing floor tiles are replaced to prevent ponding water or debris accumulation in the above mentioned areas.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Observed a bottle of sanitizer to be stored on a ledge above the prep cooler. Discussed with PIC and the bottle was placed on a shelf away from open food. Ensure that poisonous chemicals are stored in a manner that protects against contamination. 

7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
There is a leaking pipe at the handwashing sink along the cook-line. The leaking pipe must be repaired. Ensure that pipes are maintained and are in leak-free condition. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.
